Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- What we covered: POC scope (10k tokens/day average, burst to 40k), data residency requirement (US-only), success criteria (latency <200ms 95th, cost target ~$0.002/token on average).
- Action items for Amplify Health: share your vendor W-9 and preferred ACH bank details so our procurement team can start the vendor setup.
- Action items for Redwood: we’ll prepare a POC SOW and share a draft invoice template for budgeting; Ben will own the procurement handoff.

If you can send the W-9 and ACH info this week that would keep us on track to start the POC in early July. If procurement timing has shifted on your side, let me know — happy to adjust.

Attachments: (I didn’t attach files to avoid sending sensitive banking fields over email)

Thanks —
